name: kettlebell-push-up
instructions:
1. Assume a quadruped position on the floor with your hands on kettlebells, toes tucked, and knees under hips.
2. Extend one leg at a time and assume an extra wide stance. Keep the elbows extended and head in a neutral position looking at the floor.
3. Slowly descend to the floor by retracting the shoulder blade and unlocking the elbow.
4. Descend until the upper arm is parallel or your chest reaches slightly below the kettlebells.
5. Push back to the starting point by extending the elbow and driving your palm into the kettlebells.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
